defects_found_and_fixed: The real in-app updater smoke was conditionally skipped for every version after 1.0.10; the condition is now version-independent and fails loudly when its pinned base is missing.
The published 1.0.9 client was seeded with the repo migrator, planting revision 0006_item_catalog that a released client cannot resolve; published clients are now seeded on their own revision.
Delta coverage lists were frozen per version; coverage now follows the built version and requires three older direct baselines.
Packaging had a single unretried PSGallery install that failed one run; it now retries three times and still fails loudly.
build_deltas wrote SHA256SUMS before signing and never included the signature; signing now happens first and the signature is checksummed.

open_items_blocking_publication.detail: Generate the Ed25519 keypair and store the private key as the repository secret VIRA_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY. This GitHub App token cannot read or write Actions secrets (HTTP 403), and the private key must never live in this repository or in chat. Guide: docs/releases/update-signing-key-guide-fa.md.
COMPLETE_COMPONENT_LEGAL_REVIEW, COMPILER_CRT_TERMS, RECIPIENT_SOURCE_DELIVERY, LGPL EULA rights and installed-user acceptance remain open; no technical change closes them.

unchanged: MIT scope limited to 14 native PDF build files
resolved_since_last_record: The real in-app updater browser audit now passes end to end for the published 1.0.9 client (run 40515124158).
A packaged release now bakes the Ed25519 verification key, so an installed client actually enforces latest.json signatures; previously the signature existed but no installed client would check it.
